title: Deborah Ann Woll Will Play Faye in Prime Video's God of War Series
excerpt:
The actress behind Faye in God of War Ragnarök is returning to the character in live action.
Her casting connects Prime Video's adaptation directly to the acclaimed PlayStation games.
body_md:
Deborah Ann Woll has been cast as Faye, also known as Laufey, in Prime Video's live-action adaptation of God of War. The choice brings an established performer from the games into the television production: Woll previously portrayed Faye through voice performance in God of War Ragnarök. Her involvement offers a direct connection between the screen adaptation and the source material.

Faye is the late wife of Kratos and mother of Atreus. Her death sets the father and son on their journey, while discoveries about her past challenge what they believed they knew about her. Although she is absent at the beginning of the central story, her influence shapes its emotional stakes and many of its revelations. The production has not yet explained how extensively the television version will depict her through flashbacks or other storytelling devices.

Dave Bautista leads the cast as Kratos, with Callum Vinson playing Atreus. Mandy Patinkin and Ed Skrein are also among the announced performers. Other cast members include Teresa Palmer, Alastair Duncan, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson and Max Parker. The series draws on Sony's PlayStation franchise, though the precise structure of its adaptation and the extent to which it will reproduce individual game scenes have not been detailed.

The project has undergone significant changes since Prime Video gave it a series order in 2022. A change in showrunners followed in 2024. Production began in 2026 but was interrupted after Ryan Hurst, originally cast as Kratos, suffered an on-set injury in July and subsequently left the role. Bautista was cast in August, with plans to resume filming in Vancouver during the fall. Woll's casting is therefore another major step as the production moves forward.

Ronald D. Moore, whose credits include Outlander and Battlestar Galactica, serves as showrunner and executive producer. Sony Pictures Television and Amazon MGM Studios are producing in association with PlayStation Productions and Tall Ship Productions. Frederick E. O. Toye, known for work on Shōgun and Fallout, is directing the first two episodes.

Woll is also known for playing Karen Page in Daredevil and for her work on True Blood. She is due to reprise Faye in the upcoming game God of War: Laufey as well. No confirmed premiere date for the Prime Video series was provided with this casting announcement, so any specific release window should not be treated as official without further confirmation.
